rules.operation_state: 最頻の関数共通状態を一関数一度だけ自然言語でcommon_expectation_boundaryに置き、各行は別状態のみ残す。
rules.field_judgment: 同じconditionの言い直しを除去し、異なる未観測枝だけ行に残す。
rules.retained_state: 旧44行の保持差分をJSON serializationなしの平文にする。
rules.digest_source: 元期待return SHAは既存case-row-mapの値を参照し、全返却値は複製しない。

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F01.common_state: abは方向が確定せず未送信で保持、baは方向が確定せず未送信で保持

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F02.common_state: successorは後続edgeを保留、original initial resultはretained

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F03.common_state: edge candidatesはedge-a=content edge inputs correspond require actual qualification、edge-b=content edge inputs correspond require actual qualification、joinはheld join、composite completeはFalse

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F04.common_state: typed relationはheld relation、feedback sendはreturn relationを未送信で保持、receivedはFalse、resolvedはFalse、approvedはFalse、task completeはFalse

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F05.common_state: additional retry candidateは0、loop resolutionはunfinished、original initial resultはretained、session reset allowedはFalse

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F06.common_state: initial edge candidateは初回edgeを保留、feedback send candidateは未評価、additional retry candidateは0、join candidateは未評価、ack candidateは未評価

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F07.common_state: initial edge candidateは初回結果を保持、feedback send candidateはreturn relationを未送信で保持、additional retry candidateは0、join candidateは未評価、ack candidateは未評価

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F08.common_state: initial edge candidateは初回結果を保持、feedback send candidateは未評価、additional retry candidateは0、join candidateは未評価、ack candidateは未評価

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F09.common_state: initial edge candidateは初回結果を保持、feedback send candidateは未評価、additional retry candidateは0、join candidateはheld join、ack candidateは未評価

HELIXCONNECT-L5-009-F10.common_state: initial edge candidateは初回結果を保持、feedback send candidateは未評価、additional retry candidateは0、join candidateは未評価、ack candidateはwaiting ack or missing original attempt

rows.retained_delta_plain_text: 元の保持状態の記録なし、保持判定はunknown
